prompt: For each payment of subscriptions 1 to 20 (subscription_id from 1 to 20, both included), the report needs the moment of the subscription's latest payment beside the payment's own paid_at. No subscription has two payments at the same moment. Which query returns that, with the columns subscription_id, payment_id, paid_at and last_paid_at?

options.text:
SELECT subscription_id, payment_id, paid_at,
       LAST_VALUE(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id ORDER BY paid_at) AS last_paid_at
FROM payments
WHERE subscription_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20

SELECT subscription_id, payment_id, paid_at,
       LAST_VALUE(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id ORDER BY paid_at
                                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_paid_at
FROM payments
WHERE subscription_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20

SELECT subscription_id, payment_id, paid_at,
       FIRST_VALUE(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id ORDER BY paid_at
                                  ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_paid_at
FROM payments
WHERE subscription_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20

SELECT subscription_id, payment_id, paid_at,
       LAST_VALUE(paid_at) OVER (ORDER BY paid_at
                                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_paid_at
FROM payments
WHERE subscription_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
